name: Ujjain
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The official Ujjain District land-records page routes to Madhya Pradesh Bhulekh and lists Lok Seva Kendra service locations including Ujjain. The official Hindi route confirms the same. The district GIS page describes infrastructure and land-use layers, while its published map service contains planning/base layers, not cadastral parcel records. Registry access exists through state records, but no public safe parcel geometry was verified at the exact urban locator.
remainingUncertainty: Whether additional safe anonymous parcel-geometry services or broader source coverage exist; no citywide coverage is claimed.
scopeLimits: Review covers the exact unchanged WUP settlement locator and identified official sources only. No owner, address, personal-property, tax, account, token or credential data requested or retained. No citywide completeness claimed.
